entries.title: Philippians 2:1
segments: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassions,

entries.title: Philippians 2:2
segments: make full my joy, that ye be of the same mind, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

entries.title: Philippians 2:3
segments: [doing] nothing through faction or through vainglory, but in lowliness of mind each counting other better than himself;

entries.title: Philippians 2:4
segments: not looking each of you to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

entries.title: Philippians 2:5
segments: Have this mind in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

entries.title: Philippians 2:6
segments: who, existing in the form of God, counted not the being on an equality with God a thing to be grasped,

entries.title: Philippians 2:7
segments: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men;

entries.title: Philippians 2:8
segments: and being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, becoming obedient [even] unto death, yea, the death of the cross.

entries.title: Philippians 2:9
segments: Wherefore also God highly exalted him, and gave unto him the name which is above every name;

entries.title: Philippians 2:10
segments: that in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of [things] in heaven and [things] on earth and [things] under the earth,

entries.title: Philippians 2:11
segments: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

entries.title: Philippians 2:12
segments: So then, my beloved, even as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;

entries.title: Philippians 2:13
segments: for it is God who worketh in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.

entries.title: Philippians 2:14
segments: Do all things without murmurings and questionings:

entries.title: Philippians 2:15
segments: that ye may become blameless and harmless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom ye are seen as lights in the world,

entries.title: Philippians 2:16
segments: holding forth the word of life; that I may have whereof to glory in the day of Christ, that I did not run in vain neither labor in vain.

entries.title: Philippians 2:17
segments: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all:

entries.title: Philippians 2:18
segments: and in the same manner do ye also joy, and rejoice with me.

entries.title: Philippians 2:19
segments: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

entries.title: Philippians 2:20
segments: For I have no man likeminded, who will care truly for your state.

entries.title: Philippians 2:21
segments: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 2:22
segments: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a child [serveth] a father, [so] he served with me in furtherance of the gospel.

entries.title: Philippians 2:23
segments: Him therefore I hope to send forthwith, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me:

entries.title: Philippians 2:24
segments: but I trust in the Lord that I myself also shall come shortly.

entries.title: Philippians 2:25
segments: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow-worker and fellow-soldier, and your messenger and minister to my need;

entries.title: Philippians 2:26
segments: since he longed after you all, and was sore troubled, because ye had heard that he was sick:

entries.title: Philippians 2:27
segments: for indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.

entries.title: Philippians 2:28
segments: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

entries.title: Philippians 2:29
segments: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy; and hold such in honor:

entries.title: Philippians 2:30
segments: because for the work of Christ he came nigh unto death, hazarding his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
